description: Structured eval definitions for the IoT Core Thing Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across IoT Core topologies (full thing with cert + policy + triple binding, topic rule with SQL SELECT to Timestream + republish, named device shadows with delta, Greengrass component deployment to thing group, missing cert-to-thing binding prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: IoT thing with X.509 cert, policy, and both bindings (cert-thing + policy-cert)
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — thing, certificate, policy, both bindings, thing type, thing group
eval_cases.prompt: Create an IoT thing "sensor-001" in us-east-1 with X.509 certificate. Create IoT policy "sensor-publish-policy" allowing connect with client ID sensor-*, publish to device/+/telemetry, and subscribe to device/+/commands. Attach the certificate to the thing and the policy to the certificate. Thing type: temperature-sensor. Thing group: factory-floor-sensors. Tags: Environment=production, DeviceType=sensor.
eval_cases.expected_output:
IOT_THING: sensor-001 (arn:aws:iot:us-east-1:123456789012:thing/sensor-001)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Thing: sensor-001 — created
  [✓] Certificate (X.509): ACTIVE
  [✓] Certificate attached to thing: YES
  [✓] IoT policy: sensor-publish-policy — created
  [✓] Policy attached to certificate: YES
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws iot describe-thing --thing-name sensor-001 --region us-east-1
  aws iot list-thing-principals --thing-name sensor-001 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Topic rule with SQL SELECT to Timestream and republish action
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — topic rule SQL against payload, Timestream write, republish to alerts, IAM role
eval_cases.prompt: Create an IoT topic rule "telemetry-to-timestream" in us-east-1. SQL: SELECT temperature, humidity, device_id FROM 'device/+/telemetry' WHERE temperature > 30. Actions: write to Timestream database sensors table telemetry, and republish to device/alerts. IAM role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/IoTTopicRuleRole. Error action: republish to device/errors. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
IOT_THING: topic rule telemetry-to-timestream
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Topic rule: telemetry-to-timestream — SQL: SELECT temperature, humidity FROM 'device/+/telemetry' WHERE temperature > 30
  [✓] Topic rule IAM role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/IoTTopicRuleRole
  [✓] Topic rule actions: Timestream, Republish

eval_cases.name: IoT thing with named device shadows for config and firmware state
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — named shadows (config, firmware) for multi-aspect device state management
eval_cases.prompt: Create an IoT thing "actuator-001" in us-east-1 with X.509 certificate and IoT policy for pub/sub. Configure named device shadows: "config" for configuration state and "firmware" for firmware version state. The device should receive delta notifications. Thing group: factory-actuators. Tags: Environment=production, DeviceType=actuator.
eval_cases.expected_output:
IOT_THING: actuator-001
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Thing: actuator-001 — created
  [✓] Certificate (X.509): ACTIVE
  [✓] Device shadow: named:config, named:firmware

eval_cases.name: Greengrass V2 component deployment to thing group
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — component deployed to edge thing group with configuration merge
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Greengrass V2 component deployment in us-east-1. Component: com.example.TelemetryAgent version 1.0.0. Deploy to thing group factory-edge-devices. Configuration: sampleRate=5s. Tags: Environment=production, EdgeCompute=greengrass.
eval_cases.expected_output:
IOT_THING: greengrass deployment
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Greengrass: com.example.TelemetryAgent:1.0.0 deployed to factory-edge-devices

eval_cases.name: Certificate not attached to thing (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — cert exists but not attached to thing; device cannot connect
eval_cases.prompt: Create an IoT thing "device-001" in us-east-1. I already have a certificate but haven't attached it to the thing. Create an IoT policy for connect and publish. Tags: Environment=dev.
eval_cases.expected_output:
IOT_THING: device-001
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Certificate attached to thing: MISSING — certificate exists but is not attached to the thing; device cannot connect without cert-to-thing binding
